entities.summary: The Kinuura Rinkai Railway Handa Line  is a freight-only railway line owned and operated by the Kinuura Rinkai Railway in Handa, Aichi, Japan, since 1975. The line extends 3.4 km (2.1 mi) from Higashi-Narawa Station to the terminal at Handa-Futō.
